name: asn_sfn_derivation
description: Duration-parametric time-counter derivation from Unix UTC microseconds. With a slot duration, the unbounded quotient is an Absolute Slot Number (ASN, u64); with a superframe duration, its low 32 bits are the TDMA SFN. Recording both projections does not assert that slot and superframe durations are equal. Unix time has no distinct encoding for 23:59:60; the leap-second cases therefore pin the consecutive representable instants on either side of the 2016-12-31 leap second. Expected values come from this standalone integer-arithmetic oracle, not LICHEN code.

vectors.name: at_epoch
vectors.description: The configured epoch is ASN/SFN zero.

vectors.name: before_epoch_clamps
vectors.description: A wall-clock sample before the epoch cannot produce a negative ASN.

vectors.name: last_microsecond_before_interval
vectors.description: Integer division keeps the final microsecond of an interval in ASN zero.

vectors.name: first_microsecond_of_next_interval
vectors.description: The exact interval boundary advances ASN and SFN to one.

vectors.name: leap_2016_last_representable_second_before
vectors.description: Unix UTC 2016-12-31T23:59:59Z is the last representable second before the leap boundary.

vectors.name: leap_2016_first_representable_second_after
vectors.description: Unix UTC advances directly to 2017-01-01T00:00:00Z because 23:59:60 has no distinct Unix timestamp.

vectors.name: sfn_u32_max
vectors.description: The final absolute interval before SFN epoch rollover maps to 0xffffffff.

vectors.name: sfn_u32_rollover
vectors.description: Absolute interval 2^32 is the SFN epoch rollover to wire value zero.

vectors.name: sfn_u32_after_rollover
vectors.description: The interval after SFN epoch rollover maps to one while the u64 count remains monotonic.

vectors.name: asn_u64_max
vectors.description: Unit-duration derivation reaches the maximum unsigned 64-bit ASN exactly.

vectors.name: timestamps_near_u64_max
vectors.description: Subtraction before division remains defined when both timestamps are near u64 max.

vectors.name: zero_duration_clamps
vectors.description: A zero interval duration is invalid and deterministically clamps to zero instead of dividing.
